scientific_integrity: The finite color-weight counting identity is already equivalent to published scalar-root-potent counting and is cited as prior art, not a new enumeration. The claim assessed as new is the joint spectral discrete-theta distribution and quadratic missing-spectrum rate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite field and fixed tuple length only; not uniform in growing k or q.
Some relevant full texts were inaccessible; an earlier Potts or lattice-asymptotic theorem may imply the result.
Computations are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
title: Discrete-theta spectrum law for commuting triangular idempotents
